reason: The first frozen regression run failed in both cases because no ValueError was raised, but the assertion reported optimizer_step=0. Candidate-training rollback restores optimizer_step to its incumbent value after train_step returns, making that state field unable to reveal whether the trainer call occurred.
observation: train_candidate returned normally in both malformed cases. The baseline implementation calls trainer.train_step before returning a candidate ID, so normal return establishes that the mismatched generation crossed the training boundary; the first fixture did not expose the non-snapshotted train_step_calls counter in its failure message.

instrumentation_correction.change: Report and assert FakeTrainer.train_step_calls == 0 on rejection. This counter is deliberately outside snapshot_training_state, so rollback cannot erase evidence of an optimizer-boundary call.

claim_limit: The first run is retained as an observability-limited failed fixture attempt, not as a separate research result. The corrected instrumentation will be run before implementation changes on the same baseline source.
